body: Meet the ultimate off-grid adventure vehicle, built on the rugged and reliable Sprinter 170 AWD platform. This custom camper van, part of our elite El Capitan series, is engineered for those who seek a perfect blend of luxury and functionality in their van life experience. Every detail in this van is crafted to deliver maximum comfort and convenience, making it an ideal choice for both full-time van dwellers and weekend explorers. A standout feature is the pop-top tent, which adds a whole new dimension to your van life adventures, providing extra sleeping space and an elevated view of the great outdoors.

Power and independence are at the core of this van’s design. Outfitted with a robust 400W solar system paired with an 800Ah Lithium Iron Battery and a 2500W pure sine wave inverter/charger, this van ensures you’re always powered up, even in the most remote locations. The 30A shore power plugin and 50Amp DC-DC/solar charger combo provide flexibility and reliability, making it easy to power your appliances and devices. Multiple 110v outlets with USB and USB-C ports ensure you stay connected and fully charged no matter where your adventures take you.

Step inside to find a fully-equipped kitchen that rivals those in luxury homes. The Acacia butcher block countertop, paired with a stainless steel sink and faucet, adds a touch of elegance to the space. Whether you’re cooking on the portable single burner induction cooktop or storing your groceries in the Isotherm Cruise 130 stainless steel refrigerator with freezer, this kitchen is designed to meet all your culinary needs, whether you’re on a quick trip or a long journey.

Comfort extends beyond the kitchen with a fully insulated interior, featuring premium Havelock wool insulation and insulated PEX lines. Stay cool in the summer with the 12v Roof Mounted Nomadic A/C unit and Maxxair Deluxe ceiling vent fan, and stay warm in the winter with the Espar diesel-powered cabin heater. The van also includes a spacious indoor tiled shower and a Laveo Dry Flush Toilet, ensuring that your van life experience is as comfortable and convenient as possible, no matter where you roam. The pop-top tent enhances your experience by providing a separate, airy sleeping area that connects you with nature without compromising comfort.

The aesthetic appeal of this custom camper van is undeniable, with painted shiplap siding, a wood-stained ceiling, and vinyl wood-style flooring creating a cozy and inviting space. Ample storage options, including overhead cabinets and under-counter storage, help keep your living area organized and clutter-free. Whether you’re planning a weekend getaway or embarking on a cross-country adventure, this custom camper van, complete with a versatile pop-top tent, is designed to elevate every aspect of your van life journey.
